charge_port.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port US checker lists EX90 (2025-2027) as CCS1 with an adapter included as standard from model year 2025; Volvo adapter releases (Cision, InsideEVs) cover the EX90, which a native NACS port would not need. No source announces a native NACS EX90 (Volvo first native-NACS car is the EX60).

supercharger_access.notes: Volvo Canada release: adapter included with new 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40 and orderable by current Volvo EV owners (CA$310).
US: adapter free with 2025 EX90, $230 for existing owners.
